unsupported.what: Goodman-Kruskal gamma per subject and its OLS coefficients (Table 3 row 4)
unsupported.why: gamma of five binary choices is undefined for constant sequences and the paper does not say how it handled them; no engine op

unsupported.what: Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests of the safe-choice distributions (BRIS vs H p = 0.03, BRIS vs R p = 0.02, R vs H p = 0.80), variance-ratio tests, Kendall test, equivalence tests (Table 8)
unsupported.why: no engine op for these tests; the regression rows above are the scored targets

unsupported.what: BRIS vs Real in the all-subjects negative binomial model and with controls (Supplement Table 2 row beta_B - beta_R, columns (2)-(6))
unsupported.why: the row is shifted in columns (4)-(6) (meta.paper_inconsistencies); only column (1) is an effect (safe_cons_bris_vs_real)

unsupported.what: regressions with controls and session fixed effects (Supplement Tables 1-2 columns 2-3, 5-6)
unsupported.why: age, gender, CRT and courses are not part of the served blocks (first block unknown)

keyed.why: real arm mostly consistent with 3 safe choices (10 percent switch B to A), BRIS fewer safe choices and a few inconsistent sequences, hypothetical fully consistent with 2 safe choices: consistency Real, BRIS < hypothetical, safe choices BRIS < hypothetical < Real
